text.p: Electronics based Uraco Holdings Ltd touched a new 1997 low of Singapore $0.84 in early active dealings on Tuesday.
At 0113 GMT, the stock was down 2.5 cents to S$0.855. Volume was over 2.1 million shares, including a married block of two million.
Uraco shares have been falling since Monday after reports of allegations of fraud linked to CAM International Holdings.
Uraco bought a 6.3 percent stake in CAM last year.
The Stock Exchange of Singapore has asked CAM to respond to the allegations, made in a report by auditors Ernst & Young.

The auditors have told the Finance Ministry that they had reason to believe "that a serious offence...of the Companies Act has been or is likely to have been committed" by an officer or officers of CAM in respect of certain intra-company transactions.
CAM directors have said they were not aware of any fraud against the company. Trading in CAM shares has been suspended since April 30.
